panels.scene: Pansy in green supports Robin at her hip with one arm and uses her other hand to guide one short wand. A few empty stemmed glasses float through the oak arch to the dining table several feet away. Baby claps, no glass near his hands.
dialogue: Pansy: Al menos alguien en esta familia sabe reconocer un hechizo bien hecho.

panels.scene: Hermione at LEFT carries the single pudding plate in two hands. Pansy at RIGHT holds Robin and answers with a proud smile. Glasses have settled on the table. Two ordered balloons.
dialogue: Pansy: Si está bien hecho, merece la ovación.

panels.scene: Jane enters with several cream, deep green and red wrapped gift boxes, warm smile and a small piece of transparent tape on her cardigan cuff. Two leads listen from a little distance.
dialogue: Jane: Espero que todavía quede espacio bajo el árbol.

panels.scene: Malcolm appears carrying a natural large ginger cat with red bow and gold bell. His navy knit has the enormous tan reindeer with green scarf and little glowing red bulb nose, the joke is unmistakable.

dialogue: Pansy: No pensaba hacerlo, señor Granger.
